name: PlushSource
tagline: Independent B2B directory of custom plush manufacturers, with an MCP server for agents.
description: PlushSource is an independent B2B directory of custom plush manufacturers. Each listing records where a manufacturer operates, their minimum order quantities, services, certifications and the clients they serve. PlushSource is a directory, not a store: every listing links to the manufacturer's own website. For AI agents it publishes an MCP server (plushsource-mcp on npm, stdio, no API key) and an llms.txt file at https://plushsource.com/llms.txt. Human-made, compiled from each manufacturer's own site.
